title: Stellar Odyssey
description: My take on an End update! Adds new biomes, mobs, plants, and ore to the End!
body:
Stellar Odyssey is my take on a end update! This mod is a heavy work in progress and I only condiser it to be in a beta for the time being! So far there are two new biomes that are in the mod, both being closely realted to each other. They are the solar desert and lunar desert! They are both deserts made from their respective celestial dust (aka stardust and moondust). They both also feature their own stone types starstone and moonstone, which can also be crafted from stardust and moondust just like ordinary sandstone. Stardust and moondust can also be smelted to make starglass and moonglass. Both deserts have their own grass, a new cactus called dragon tooth cactus, and a new hostile mob known as the mumified enderman. Dragon tooth cactus grow a new fruit known as ender dragon fruit, not only is it a decent food source but it also provides a renewable way to make dragons breath! The new mob mumified enderman are just like regular enderman but are hostile yet weaker. Solar deserts also have another decorative plant known as suncullents (a word play on real life succullents). Currently lunar deserts don't have a second plant but that is something I plan on adding. Each biome also has their own version of a desert well that also comes with a unique pottery sherd. Outside of the new biomes there is also a new armor enchantment called dislocating which can teleport mobs away from you when you are attacked, this enchantment is only found in The End. Chorus fruit can also be brewed into teleportation potions which act exactly like chorus fruit but stronger.

TLDR: This mod adds two new sister biomes known as the solar desert and lunar desert. Both comes with new plants, a new hostile mob based off of enderman, and new sand and new sandstone, and new desert wells that provide new pottery sherds. New End City enchantment called dislocating can be found. Chrous fruit can be brewed into teleportation potions.

Planned Features: 
  
  -Overseer: An alive eye of the ender that is hostile. Functions as the End's guardsmen lore wise. In the mod currently but are a bit jank and can only be spawned in creative.
  
  -New Structures: including smaller pyramids and something thats more on scale with an end city or end version of a trial chamber. Also had the idea of wrecked isolated end city ships.
  
  -Renewable Source of Elytra: probably involved with a new structure like mentioned above.
  
  -Recall Potion: an upgrade of a teleprotaion potion that teleports you to your spawn point. In the mod currently but don't function 100% correctly yet and only avaiable in creative.
  
  -New Lunar Plant: as mentioned before I want to make another plant for the lunar desert that poses as it's version of the solar desert's suncullent.
  
  -Solar and Lunar Desert Oasis Mini Biomes: I want to add oasis to both the solar and lunar desert that also come with new wood sets and plants. 

Can I use this in my mod pack?: YES!!! (:

Thank you for reading about my mod! It would mean a lot if you tried it! I also would really appreciate any feedback or suggestions!
